title: Finite H-Tilt Shifted Stationarity Transfer
summary: A Lean-verified theorem showing that generator-style stationarity under the unnormalized survivor weight transfers to stationarity of the shifted discrete Doob kernel A=cI+K, using the verified shift bridge identity.

proves: If the generator-style Doob transform is stationary under q_i h_i, then the shifted discrete Doob kernel for A=cI+K is stationary under the same unnormalized weight.
The corresponding normalized stationarity identity when the survivor normalization is nonzero.
The proof uses only the algebraic shift bridge and finite delta-sum identity.
does_not_prove: Construction of a suitable shift c.
